newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Coryo Merchant sets 38-for-100 rights.
newsitem.headline: Coryo Merchant sets 38-for-100 rights.

text.p: South Korea's Coryo Merchant Bank said on Tuesday it planned to offer a 38-for-100 rights issue in January 1997 to raise operating funds.
Coryo will issue two million common shares and offer 20 percent of them to employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of December 21 for rights.
Subscription is set for January 23 and 24, with payment due by February 5, a statement from Coryo said.
The rights issue will be made at a 20 percent discount to a base issue price which will be announced later, it said.
The issue will raise Coryo's paid-in capital to 31 billion won from 21 billion.
Shares of Coryo rose 460 won to close at 8,270 on Tuesday.
